title: pipe operation
description: Pipe-segment pressure drop. Single-phase by default (Darcy-Weisbach with the friction factor from the `model` slot — Churchill, Haaland or Colebrook); declaring a `twoPhase` block switches to a gas-liquid multiplier method. Elevation is signed: a rise costs pressure. The outlet stream is the inlet at the reduced pressure — a pipe transports, it does not separate.

geometry.title: Line geometry
geometry.description: The physical line. Diameter, length and roughness are required; elevation change and fittings are optional.

roughness.title: Absolute roughness
roughness.description: Wall roughness eps (4.6e-5 m for commercial steel).

dz.title: Elevation change
dz.description: Outlet height minus inlet height. Positive (a rise) costs pressure.

fittings.title: Fittings
fittings.description: `( { K <loss coefficient>; count <n>; } ... )` — resistance coefficients; `count` defaults to 1.

viscosity.title: Liquid viscosity override
viscosity.description: Use the declared liquid viscosity instead of the package's model. An explicit, announced aid for the case where a trace dissolved component has no viscosity correlation — never a silent default.

twoPhase.title: Two-phase method
twoPhase.description: Present = solve the segment as gas-liquid flow. Absent = single-phase.

model.title: Two-phase model
model.description: LockhartMartinelli (separated-flow multiplier, the validated air-water route) or homogeneous (mixture properties).
